findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in a list without a key
findings.body: The `grafana` branch of `rules.map` returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` without `key={key}`. The removed `GrafanaRuleLoader` had one, and the `datasource` and default branches still pass one. The list grows incrementally through infinite scroll, so React falls back to index-based reconciliation. This causes key warnings and can attach component state (open menus, the silence drawer, the delete modal) to the wrong rule as items are appended.

findings.title: Delete and Pause are never shown in the list view even when the prom abilities allow them
findings.body: `canDelete`/`canPause` can now be true from `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`. However, the Delete item is still gated by `rulerRule &&` and the Pause item by `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123). The list view now passes only `promRule`, so users with delete or update permission can no longer delete or pause rules from the list. The new GrafanaGroupLoader test grants AlertingRuleDelete yet asserts exactly 4 menu items, which locks this regression in.

findings.title: Silence menu item does nothing when only promRule is available
findings.body: The menu shows 'Silence notifications' based on prom abilities, and clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer`. The drawer itself only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the list view `rule` (the ruler rule) is now always undefined, so clicking Silence silently does nothing.

findings.title: Federated rule check dropped from legacy useAllAlertRuleAbilities
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(CombinedRule)` previously used `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` to mark rules immutable. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. Federated Mimir rules shown in the legacy list and detail views now report Update, Delete and Pause as supported, allowing edits that shouldn't be offered.

findings.title: Prom-based abilities exclude Grafana recording rules from Export/Pause/Restore
findings.body: The ruler-based version gated ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently on `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which covers recording rules too. The prom version uses `isAlertingRule = prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, which is false for Grafana recording rules. In the new list view, recording rules lose the Export (and Pause) actions. The comment above says 'All GrafanaPromRuleDTO rules are Grafana-managed', which suggests `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule` was intended.

findings.title: returnTo parameter dropped from rule view link
findings.body: The removed implementation built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new item omits `returnTo`, so after opening a rule from a filtered or grouped list, the view page's back navigation no longer returns to the user's previous list state.

findings.title: Stale doc comments still reference Ruler loading
findings.body: The doc comment still says the group is loaded 'from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints', but the Ruler query was removed. Similarly, the comment in prometheusGroupsGenerator.ts about preloading ruler rules (and the variable name `cacheAndRulerPreload`) no longer reflects the code, since the ruler prefetch was deleted.
